OriginLocation=Center on an EVEN lattice - 4x4 - which is the case with no exact centre cell, so the implementation must pick a convention and hold it. Center is the fifth OriginLocationEnum member and the only one that is not a corner. StepSize carries no Units, so it falls back to the Layout's DefaultUnits.
